Learn more Comments 9 In this video Description Tim Cook’s replacement as Apple CEO: Who is John Ternus? | ABC NEWS 76Likes12,866ViewsApr 202026 John Ternus has been named the next Apple chief executive, replacing incumbent Tim Cook in September. The mechanical engineer is tipped to bring stability to the company as it seeks a revamp in the artificial intelligence race. The New York Times’ technology correspondent Mike Isaac says Apple still has a few tricks up its sleeve and new products such as smart glasses could be rolled out under the new CEO.
